details:
（Machine translation from Japanese to English.）

The video player has recently become indispensable for VRChat.

Sometimes I can't watch Youtube.

I think Youtube is trying to find a way to block access, since there are no benefits at all, such as not being counted in the play count or not playing ads.

However, this can be reversed by making good use of VRC+.

If we tie up with Youtube and allow VRC+ subscribers and Youtube Premium subscribers to watch videos without restrictions on VRC, the number of VRC+ subscribers will increase and the number of Youtube Premium subscribers will increase, so it should be a win-win. win-win. win-win relationship I think it will be a win-win-win situation.

Of course, if this happens, it will be necessary to develop an API that allows easy authentication tied to user IDs that can be used by video player developers.

In addition to Youtube, a partnership with D-Anime Store is also possible.

It would be nice if VRC+ subscribers and D-Anime Store subscribers could get together to watch anime, making the everyday life of the VRC world even more lively.

I don't know if this is realistically possible or not, as I am an amateur.

However, I hope that you will consider partnering with such an outside service in the future!

Thank you in advance for your consideration.
title: Propose partnerships with external services that add value to VRCPlus
